description:
Service Desk Agent with German

We are currently seeking a talented individual to join our team as a Service Desk Agent with proficiency in German. As a Service Desk Agent, you will play a crucial role in providing exceptional customer support and technical assistance to our clients in the German markets.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Responding to customer inquiries and providing timely and accurate solutions via phone, email, or chat - in German
  • Troubleshooting IT technical issues (software, hardware, peripherals) and escalating complex cases to the appropriate teams (you will receive training for this)
  • Documenting customer interactions and resolutions in the ticketing system - In English
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure customer satisfaction

Requirements:

  • Fluency in German language (B2+ - C1)
  • Good English language skill (minimum B2)
  • Excellent communication skills and a customer-oriented approach
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail
  • Prior experience in a customer service, technical or IT support role is a plus
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and handle multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Availability to work in shifts
  • Baccalaureate Degree or, preferably University Degree

Benefits:

  • You will enjoy a comprehensive, locally competitive benefits package (Regina Maria medical insurance, Bookster, 7Card & more, 24 days of vacation per year)
  • Undetermined period employment contract & stable project
  • Remote work from wherever in Romania
  • Professional growth and development through training programs and career advancement opportunities
  • Opportunity to work in a multicultural environment and interact with clients from diverse backgrounds
  • Collaborative and supportive team environment
  • Working for a top 5 company in the IT service industry worldwide

If you are passionate about delivering exceptional customer service, fluent in German, and thrive in a dynamic work setting, we would love to hear from you. Join our team as a Service Desk Agent and be part of a rewarding and fulfilling career!
